info.title: Garmin Connect web API (observed, unofficial)
info.description: Reverse-engineered from the calls the Garmin Connect web app makes in a logged-in browser. Not published or supported by Garmin and subject to change without notice. Shapes were captured as key paths and types only (no values) for one account: all properties are optional, enums and units are unknown, and fields that were always empty during the capture are absent. Authentication was not captured and is not described here. The web app reaches these services under `/gc-api/`; `x-gc-api-path` gives the same path without that prefix, which is the form `gc api` takes (to be confirmed per endpoint). Dynamic object keys (device ids, dates) are shown as `additionalProperties`. Personal identifiers were replaced by placeholders.
